spec.description:
ProctorPassive Wraptite SA Tape is a self-adhering,
vapour-permeable air barrier tape and transition strip. Constructed from a
triple-layer spunbonded polypropylene with a vapour-permeable microporous film
and a fully coated pressure-sensitive adhesive backing, it combines continuous
airtightness with vapour breathability. Designed for detailing window and door
openings, cross-laminated timber (CLT) joints, precast concrete seams, and
membrane transitions, it stops air leakage while allowing damp framing to dry
outward.
features:
Fully self-adhesive backing adheres aggressively to
timber, steel, concrete, and masonry

Vapour permeable Class 4 rating allows
structures to breathe and dry out

Acts as a certified air barrier preventing
air leakage and convective heat loss

Water barrier performance resists rain
penetration during construction

Split release paper backing allows fast,
accurate alignment into 90-degree corners

Replaces mechanical fasteners,
eliminating nail and staple penetrations

High tear strength and puncture
resistance

Low VOC emissions compliant with Green Star and Passive House
standards

technical.value:
Triple-layer polypropylene with microporous film and full-surface PSA
backing
75 mm, 100 mm, 150 mm, 200 mm, 300 mm width x 50 m length

spec.fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2; Group 1 fire performance in
compliant wall systems
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2:2017,
AS 1530.2, BBA certified, Passive House approved
spec.sustainability:
Low VOC
emissions; zero ODP; non-toxic
install:
Ensure substrate (timber,
concrete, steel, or sheathing) is clean, dry, and dust-free

Apply compatible
primer to porous concrete or masonry if required

Measure and cut Wraptite SA
tape to length
Peel back the initial section of the split release liner
Position tape along the joint, corner, or window reveal

Gradually peel
remaining liner while smoothing tape firmly onto the substrate

Consolidate
bond across the entire tape surface with a firm hand roller or squeegee
Overlap adjoining tape pieces by minimum 50mm
selection_checklist:
Select width based on detail (75/100mm for panel joints, 150/300mm for window
reveals and slab edges)

Confirm requirement for vapour permeability to
prevent moisture entrapment

Check substrate condition to determine if primer
is needed
Ensure application temperature is within recommended range
limitations:
Do not apply to wet,
frosty, or contaminated surfaces

Requires firm rolling pressure to activate
full pressure-sensitive bond

Must not remain exposed to permanent UV beyond
rated exposure window
spec.warranty:
Backed by Proctor Group Australia product
warranty

air leakage through

use_cases:
Airtight and
weathertight sealing of panel joints in cross-laminated timber (CLT) and mass
timber buildings

Flashing and air sealing window and door openings to
exterior building wraps

Sealing joints between precast concrete panels and
floor slab edges without trapping moisture
retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorPassive Wraptite SA Tape is
a full-surface self-adhering, Class 4 vapour-permeable air and weather barrier
tape. Manufactured from a triple-layer polypropylene laminate with an aggressive
pressure-sensitive adhesive backing, it seals joints in mass timber (CLT),
precast concrete, and window openings without trapping moisture in structural
framing. Fully certified as an airtight barrier with a Flammability Index ≤ 5
(AS 1530.2), it replaces mechanical fixings to deliver robust, airtight envelope
continuity for Passive House and high-performance buildings.
